description: 1962 is the Year of the Water Tiger in the Chinese zodiac, from February 5, 1962 to January 24, 1963. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1962 is the Year of the Water Tiger, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 5, 1962 and ended on January 24, 1963, so people born in 1962 before Feb 5 belong to the Metal Ox year.

sections.heading: When the 1962 Water Tiger year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1962 Water Tiger year began at Lunar New Year on February 5, 1962 and lasted until January 24, 1963, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 5 1962 therefore belongs to the Metal Ox year that started in 1961, while someone born in early 1963, up to Jan 24, is still a Water Tiger. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Water Tiger combination also falls in 2022, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1962 fell on a Monday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Water Tiger personality
paragraphs: Imaginative, empathetic and open-minded, the Water Tiger pairs courage with sensitivity. Water nourishes the Tiger's Wood, which tradition reads as a softening, deepening influence. People born in this year tend to persuade without force and sense what others need. Indecision is the usual hurdle, so setting deadlines and committing to a direction is often advised. Their kindness gives their bravery real depth.

Water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication. Descriptions associate it with wisdom, empathy and the ability to find a way around obstacles rather than through them. Water-year people are often portrayed as perceptive listeners, diplomatic and quietly persuasive, able to sense the mood of a room before anyone speaks. The element is linked with reflection and with the unseen, so it adds an inward, thoughtful layer. Its shadow, in most readings, is drift: indecision, secrecy, and a tendency to take on the shape of whoever is nearby.

sections.heading: 1962 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 9, the number of completion, generosity and letting go, and a 9 year is traditionally read as one of endings that clear space. The digits of 1962 add up to 18, which reduces to 9. In the twelve-year cycle the Tiger is the third animal, earthly branch Yin, with Wood as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Water, and in the five-element cycles water generates Wood. The year before was the Metal Ox and the year after is the Water Rabbit.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Ren-Yin: Ren is the Water heavenly stem and Yin is the Tiger's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1962?
faq.answer: 1962 is the Year of the Water Tiger. It started on February 5, 1962 and ended on January 24, 1963.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1962?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 5. Born before February 5, 1962, you are a Metal Ox; born on or after it, you are a Water Tiger.

faq.question: What element is 1962 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yang year. The Tiger's own fixed element is Wood; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1962?
faq.answer: Ren-Yin. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Tiger year?
faq.answer: 2022, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2022.
